messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: PagerDuty incident fired -> PD#63421 (synth-canary-tls-eof). Canary prober eu-west reports repeated TLS EOF during probe handshake, failure rate > 10% in last 2m. https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENTS/63421 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident PD#63421 created and routed to SRE on-call (sre-liz). Auto-escalation in 8m if unacked.
sre-liz: acked the page. I'll take initial triage.
eng-ops-max: joining. saw similar noise earlier but it was apac, not eu-west. any config churn?
infra-bot: recent deploys: canary-prober:rollout v2.14 -> 1714998000 (eu-west nodes only). TTL=30s, TLS timeout=3s.
product-ash: reporting from support: a couple customers noted failed healthchecks on their side, not production traffic. likely synthetic-only but want to confirm.
sre-liz: running quick curl against prober endpoint in eu-west host group.

sre-liz: ```bash
# quick probe against canary target
curl -v --max-time 5 https://canary-target.eu-west.internal/health || true
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to canary-target.eu-west.internal (10.1.2.3) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake starts...
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLS read: EOF returned
* Connection #0 to host canary-target.eu-west.internal left intact
curl: (18) transfer closed with outstanding read data
```

sre-liz: logs from prober instance show repeated 'TLS EOF' inside OpenSSL lib during ServerHello parse. snippet: 
infra-bot: ```
[1715000001] prober-eu-west-3 prober: attempt=5 target=https://canary-target  error="tls: unexpected EOF"
[1715000002] prober-eu-west-1 prober: attempt=6 target=https://canary-target  error="tls: unexpected EOF"
[1715000005] prober-eu-west-2 prober: attempt=4 target=https://canary-target  error="tls: unexpected EOF"
```

eng-ops-max: could be a kernel/CVE-triggering TLS bug or a library mismatch after the v2.14 rollout. any node-level conn drops?
sre-liz: netstats look clean. no bulk conn reset, just handshake aborts. CPU/mem normal.
product-ash: if it's just canary probes failing, we should suppress noisy pages quickly — don't want PD storm.
sre-liz: proposing short mitigations: 1) mute PD routing for this check -> suppress pages 2) increase TLS handshake timeout to 8s for canary to tolerate transient delays 3) roll back prober image on eu-west to v2.13 if muting+timeout doesn't stabilize.
eng-ops-max: +1 on mute now. I'll run the mute and a quick config patch to bump timeout.

eng-ops-max: ```bash
# mute pagerduty service for synth-canary-eu-west
pdctl incidents mute --service synth-canary-eu-west --duration 30m --reason "investigating TLS EOFs"
# patch prober config
kubectl -n prober set env ds/prober TLS_TIMEOUT=8 --context=eu-west
```

eng-ops-max: pdctl output: Muted service synth-canary-eu-west for 30m (PD#63421 suppressed). kubectl rollout triggered for prober daemonset (eu-west).

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD#63421 state -> acknowledged by sre-liz. Suppression active.

oncall-ryan: taking 07:40-08:10 handoff. if rollback needed ping me.
sre-liz: watching new rollout, running golden checks. will call for rollback if errors persist beyond 5 minutes.
infra-bot: prober rollout eu-west succeeded on 3 nodes (prober v2.14 w/ TLS_TIMEOUT=8). health endpoints reporting OK internally.
sre-liz: post-patch probe test: 

sre-liz: ```bash
# re-run probe
curl -v --max-time 10 https://canary-target.eu-west.internal/health || true
* Connected...
* TLS handshake complete
* HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"ok":true}
```

sre-liz: good sign — TLS handshake completed. failure rate dropping to 0.7% in last 2m.
product-ash: confirming support ticket update: mark as "synthetic-only, no customer-facing impact" for now.
eng-ops-max: leaving the mute in place for another 20m while we monitor. will open a follow-up ticket to root-cause the v2.14 handshake regression.
sre-liz: filing RCA ticket and tagging infra + runtime teams. PD#63421 will be closed if stable for next 30m.
incident-bot: PD#63421 -> status: under investigation (muted).

oncall-ryan: handoff noted. if anything noisy comes back ping @eng-ops-max and I'll escalate. closing my shift. :white_check_mark:
sre-liz: moving to post-incident follow-up: collecting all prober and openssl versions, will paste into RCA ticket. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:"
